messages:
sasha: T-minus 45m before the change window. We're in freeze for non-essential pushes. Quick sync: freeze lift criteria, pin plan, and emergency holdpoints. Anyone see a blocker?
lina: +1 on quick sync. Need to clarify freeze-extension process: who can approve + how many approvers needed for an exemption?
tom: suggest: freeze-extension requires 2 approvers (EngLead + PM) in-thread and a ticket update. Hotfix exemptions still allowed if sec/ops sign off.
sasha: agreed. We'll require EngLead + PM for any freeze extension. Hotfix path: file a short prod-hotfix ticket, tag #release-hotline, get ops sign-off.
deploy-bot: planned release job queued: release-id=eu-slice-2026-04-02-01. Canary slices: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%. Each step waits for holdpoint approval or automated pass. Logs: https://logs.redwood/ci/release/eu-slice-2026-04-02-01
infra-bot: infra watchlist enabled for eu clusters. Kernel OOM guard active; will notify at 2x baseline OOMs or if network packet loss >0.5%.
lina: on pinning: we should pin the runtime binary to release-20260325 and the model to v1.5.0-rc1 for the controlled rollout. Runtime fallback to release-20260310 if health fails.
sasha: pin decisions noted. We'll pin both. Also: quiet-window start at deploy+10m for 30m, then extended quiet period if 0 incidents.
tom: rollback triggers I want on the table: 1) 1%+ user-facing error rate sustained for 5m, 2) p95 latency > 3s for 3m, 3) any customer-visible regression reported by CSM during the canary.
sasha: add: correlated 5xx across two or more regions for 2m -> abort. Manual abort channel: #release-hotline.
release-hotline-bot: Monitoring channel #release-hotline active. Pager rotation: on-call -> eng-lead -> infra -> pm. Use command `!abort-release <reason>` to trigger a fast rollback.
lina: logging: enable sampled traces for reranker and prefix-cache keys during canary. Keep perf sampling low for full prod.
deploy-bot: canary step 1 (5%) applied. Health checks start. Metrics stream: https://dash.redwood/canary/eu-slice-2026-04-02-01
infra-bot: noticed slight uptick in worker mem across eu-west-2a, baseline +7%. Not yet critical, logging for now.
(small pause)
deploy-bot: canary 5% after 7m: errors 0.02% (5 bad requests), p95 640ms, success. Auto pass -> awaiting ramp to 25%.
sasha: proceed to 25% ramp. Holdpoint at 25% for 10m observation.
deploy-bot: ramping -> 25% now.
infra-bot: gpu temp stable; disk iops normal.
tom: observed a minor spike on the analytics ingestion endpoint, 0.4% errors correlated to backpressure. Keep watch.
lina: if analytics error climbs to 1% and doesn't drop in 5m we hold.
deploy-bot: canary 25% after 12m: errors 0.15% (40 requests), p95 1.1s. Thresholds still OK per stated triggers.
sasha: good. Prepare release notes snippet for ops: bullet list of DB index migration, reranker weights, and prefix-cache TTL changes. I'll post to the ticket.
release-hotline-bot: Reminder: to request an emergency unfreeze approval, add `!unfreeze-request <ticket>` and @englead & @pm will be pinged.
(later)
infra-bot: alert policy: if errors >1% for 3m escalate to paging. Also will escalate if p95 > 2.5s for 5m.
deploy-bot: scheduled ramp to 60% in 8m if no hold. Current metrics stable.
sasha: final procedural notes before we leave preflight: 1) pins set to release-20260325 & v1.5.0-rc1 ✅ 2) quiet-window rules documented ✅ 3) rollback triggers defined ✅ 4) #release-hotline monitored and abort command tested ✅. Proceeding unless aborts.
tom: pro tip: keep an eye on cold-cache tail latencies for the embedder, it usually shows up around 40%-60% ramp.
release-hotline-bot: If a rollback is needed use the emergency command: 
```
# emergency rollback to last stable binary + model
scripts/rollback_release --to=stable-20260325 --binary=release-20260325 --model=v1.4.3 --reason="auto/abort"
```
 sasha: thanks team. Closing preflight call: GO on my side. Will open a post-release checklist thread in #eng-releases-post when we hit 100%.
